question: Where is my order / tracking / delivery status
answer: Your order has been shipped and is expected to arrive within 3-5 business days. You can track it using the tracking number sent to your email, or visit Account > Orders > Track.

question: Refund policy / money back / cancel payment
answer: We offer a 7-day refund policy on most items. To request a refund, go to Settings > Orders > Select Order > Request Refund. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

question: Password reset / login issue / account access
answer: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. You'll receive an email with a reset link valid for 24 hours. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.

question: Invoice / bill / payment method / GST
answer: You can download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. We accept UPI, credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), net banking, and wallets. For GST invoices, add your GSTIN in billing settings.

question: Business hours / contact / support team
answer: Our AI support is available 24/7. For phone support, call us 9AM-6PM IST (Mon-Fri) at 1800-XXX-XXXX. Email: support@ticketdesk.io. Live chat is staffed 24/7 by humans as a fallback.
